subtitleNullable: 5000 highest user rated albums according to AOTY(albumoftheyear.org) users
descriptionNullable:
The data was collected from the "Best Albums of All Time" section by user score on Album of the Year (AOTY). This dataset provides a comprehensive list of top-rated albums as determined by user ratings, including information such as album titles, artists, release dates, genres, user scores, and the number of ratings each album received.

Please note that, in accordance with AOTY’s licensing terms, this data is solely intended for non-commercial and research purposes. No personal user data is included in the dataset. Instead, it reflects aggregate user contributions that have been made available under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported License. As per these terms, this data may not be used for commercial ventures and is provided to support analysis, research, or educational use.
